$comment: The Package Reference's hand-written part: each subject's title and description, the packages in it, and the summaries, limits and class descriptions the engine's sources do not give. scripts/reference.ts reads it.

documents.title: Documents and Pages
documents.description: Page layout, heads and feet, titles, columns, documents in pieces, and what goes into the PDF.

text.title: Text and Colour
text.description: Text, symbols, spacing, colour and emphasis.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: Font families and encodings, and how mLaTeX sets each one.

science.title: Science and Units
science.description: Units, numbers, chemistry and physics notation.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Table structure, rules, cells, long tables and tables from data.

floats.title: Floats and Captions
floats.description: Figures and tables that float, their captions, and pseudocode.

lists.title: Lists and Boxes
lists.description: Lists, exercises, framed and coloured boxes.

pictures.title: Pictures and Diagrams
pictures.description: Pictures, TikZ, plots, diagrams, circuits and trees.

references.title: References and Notes
references.description: Cross-references, citations, bibliographies, indexes, contents, footnotes and links.

code.title: Code and Verbatim
code.description: Source code and text set exactly as typed.

programming.title: Programming
programming.description: Logic, arithmetic, keys, hooks, dates and placeholder text, for packages and documents built from data.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: Every document class mLaTeX reads, and how it sets the page.

classes.llncs: Springer's Lecture Notes in Computer Science
classes.revtex4: APS and AIP papers, first release
classes.standalone: A piece on its own, on a page cropped to it

summaries.afterpage: Code to run once the page being set is finished
summaries.algorithm: The float pseudocode is set in, in the ruled style
summaries.amsmath: Displays, alignments, matrices and the rest; most of it is part of the engine already
summaries.amssymb: Its symbols, which are already in the mathematics font
summaries.array: More column types and `\newcolumntype`, read by `tabular` itself
summaries.bidi: Paragraphs right to left or left to right, with `\setRTL` and `\setLTR`
summaries.bohr: An atom drawn as Bohr drew it, its electrons on shells round the nucleus
summaries.booktabs: `\toprule`, `\midrule`, `\bottomrule` and `\cmidrule`, with booktabs' weights and spacing
summaries.calc: Lengths written as sums, such as `\textwidth-2cm`, and `\widthof`
summaries.changepage: `adjustwidth`, and whether the page being set is odd
summaries.cleveref: `\cref` and `\Cref`: references that name what they point to
summaries.ctable: A table and its caption in one command, with booktabs' rules
summaries.environ: `\NewEnviron`, an environment whose body is read whole into `\BODY`
summaries.fontspec: `\setmainfont` and its kin, choosing the nearest font mLaTeX carries
summaries.mathtools: amsmath's fixes and additions; loads amsmath
summaries.outlines: Outlines whose levels are `\1` to `\4`, set as nested lists
summaries.polyglossia: Languages named by command, each with a command and an environment of its own
summaries.tabu: Tables to a width with `X[l]`, `X[c]` and `X[r]` columns
summaries.xifthen: ifthen's tests, and whether a text is empty, holds another, or names a command
summaries.threeparttablex: threeparttable's notes for a long table
summaries.xspace: A space after a command unless punctuation follows
summaries.biblatex: Bibliographies from `.bib` files in biblatex's styles
summaries.pstricks: PSTricks pictures, drawn with TikZ's own commands
summaries.axodraw2: Feynman diagrams in an `axopicture`, drawn as TikZ paths
summaries.elements: The chemical elements by atomic number: symbols and names

limits.algorithm: The list of algorithms is not printed
limits.afterpage: Its code runs where it is written
limits.changepage: Every page counts as a right-hand page
limits.ctable: Set where it stands; its float keys are ignored
limits.dcolumn: Numbers are centred, not aligned on the point
limits.fancybox: Shadows, double lines and rounded corners are drawn as a plain frame
limits.feynmp: Diagrams are not drawn; their place is kept
limits.fontawesome5: Icons are the nearest Unicode symbols; brand logos are dots
limits.forest: Its own placement options are ignored
limits.glossaries: The glossary list is not printed
limits.hhline: Each rule is drawn across the whole table
limits.imakeidx: One index, whatever it is named
limits.modiagram: The diagram's place is kept as a frame
limits.needspace: Ignored; pages break where room runs out
limits.nomencl: The list of symbols is not set
limits.orcidlink: The ORCID mark is left out
limits.pgfgantt: Set as a table of tasks
limits.pgfplots: Styles for all plots at once, and group plots, are ignored
limits.pst-node: Connections between nodes are not drawn
limits.tcolorbox: Its libraries and inline boxes are ignored
limits.textpos: The block is set where it stands, not at its position
limits.titlesec: Frames and other code after the title are ignored
limits.tocloft: Its fonts and leaders are ignored
limits.url: A `%` or `#` in an address must be escaped
limits.tikz-3dplot: Coordinates in three dimensions are not drawn; the rest of the picture is
limits.fontspec: A font with nothing near it among the faces mLaTeX carries is not used; the text keeps its face, with a warning
